'''Bronchial Tubes''' are [[:Category:Blocks|Blocks]] that only serve to keep [[Alveoli Block|Alveoli Blocks]] oxygenated.
{{Item Info
|image1=Bronchial Tube.png
|id=srparasites:hair_follicle_block
}}

==''Obtainment''==
Found as tree "stems" in the [[Harlequin Biome]], and in the [[Meteor]].

==''Usage''==
Bronchial Tubes supply oxygen to [[Alveoli Block|Alveoli Blocks]] and keep them from becoming diseased when placed directly adjacent to the alveoli.
